$what: Every settlement finding that is TRUE OF PRODUCTION TODAY, so a new one is visible against a known floor instead of paging every night about three rows from July.
$why: All three paid lines in production were split at a flat 5% while carrying a platform_percent snapshot that says 10%, 10% and 100%. That is the fixed commission 070 removed from the money path, left behind on rows written before it. Demanding zero would make /api/cron/settlement-reconcile red on its first run and every run after, and an alert that is always on is an alert nobody reads.
$why_not_fixed_here: Repairing them means writing to production money rows: deciding whether the ₪799 supplier is owed ₪0 (what the percent says) or ₪759.05 (what the money says), and whether the ₪18 coupons were sold at 5% or 10%. Those are the operator's calls, and a DB write to fix them is one of the four things this agent stops for.
$how_to_shrink_this: Correct the row, then delete the entry. The job reports an entry that STOPPED firing under `silenced`, so the list cannot quietly keep names of things that were already fixed - or hide a check that broke.
